name: feature_tracers
title: Every round is a line of light
note: Each bullet from every gun draws its own glowing streak, not only the tracer rounds.

name: battleaxe_crossfire_wide
title: MG nests firing across no man's land
note: Retail draws only the tracer rounds; the remaster draws every round as light.

name: feature_mg42
title: Muzzle flashes are light
note: Each burst lights the gun, the gunner and the sandbags around them.

name: battleaxe_mg42_nest
title: An MG42 nest in the crossfire
note: Retail draws the flash; the remaster's flash also lights the gunner and the sandbags.

name: feature_flak
title: Flak bursts glow against the sky
note: Three Flak 38s firing at the sky: each shell bursts as a fireball that blooms.

name: battleaxe_flak
title: Flak over Battleaxe
note: The same guns firing in both: the remaster's bursts are light, with bloom.

name: feature_blast
title: Explosions are light
note: The Allied AA gun is destroyed: the blast blooms and lights the sand around it.

name: battleaxe_allied_aa
title: The Allied AA gun destroyed
note: The same recorded moment in both: the remaster's blast is light.

name: feature_plane_shadow
title: A real sun casts real shadows
note: Out to the fog, from everything, and they move: a Corsair eight metres up, its shadow sweeping the sand.

name: wake_plane_shadow
title: A low pass over Wake
note: Retail draws no shadow under the plane; the remaster's sun does.

name: feature_fire
title: Fire lights what is around it
note: A burning car throws flickering orange light onto the barn wall and the roof above it.

name: kharkov_fire
title: A burning Kübelwagen at dusk
note: In the remaster the fire lights the barn wall and the lean-to roof.

name: feature_water
title: Water that reflects the sky
note: The sea shows the sand in the shallows, deepens offshore and foams at the shore.

name: wake_lagoon
title: Wake's lagoon, down into the sun
note: The sky's reflection, the sandy shallows and the sun's glint, held under a beam.
